title: Trial class, from question to review
summary: Replay with simulated data, combining the WhatsApp auto-reply bot, appointment reminders and the review requester. At 11:08 pm someone asks Ironside Fitness on WhatsApp whether there's a free trial class for early mornings. The bot answers with the weekday 6 and 7 am sessions and a booking link. They book Thursday's 6 am Strength class; the trial lands in the gym's Trials sheet. On Wednesday evening they get a reminder, and on Thursday after the class a thank-you with the gym's Google review link.

steps.text: Hi, do you do a free trial class? I can only make early mornings.
We do: your first class is free. Early sessions are at 6 and 7 am on weekdays. Pick one with the booking link and we'll remind you the evening before.
Bot answered: trial class, early sessions
See you tomorrow at 6 for your free trial. Bring water and trainers; we'll have a towel for you.
Thanks for coming in this morning. If you enjoyed it, a Google review would help us a lot. One tap: the link opens our review page.
Review link sent after the class
